name: Ved Panse
headline: I build ideas all the
about: I'm a junior at University of California and a former Software Engineering Intern at Apple. I'm interested in distributed systems and AI infrastructure. I like to participate in fast-paced coding sessions (which is why you'll find me doing a lot of hackathons). In my free time, you'll usually find me at WongAvery Library trying to boot a simulated IBM 7094 to run ELIZA or learning COBOL for no practical reason.
